 Premier League form table updated ahead of 10th round of 2026-27 EPL matches
 Mark Jensen 
 6 Nov 2026 - 09:53 
 No comments 
 This is how the Premier League form table looks ahead of the tenth round of EPL matches, which include Fulham v Newcastle United.
 Everton v Coventry kicks off this round of Premier League games at 8pm on Friday night.
 Matthias Jaissle and his Newcastle United team are in action on Saturday.
 A 3pm kick-off at Craven Cottage.
 -->
 -->
 -->
 Newcastle United looking to bounce back from defeats in both cup and league to Everton
 Premier League form table on the morning of Friday 6 November 2026 
 The last six PL results for Newcastle United with very latest one listed first:
 Newcastle 0 Everton 1 
 Palace 0 Newcastle 2 
 Newcastle 0 Villa 1 
 Coventry 4 Newcastle 1 
 Newcastle 2 Hull 1 
 Leeds 4 Newcastle 1 
 -->
 As you can see, Newcastle United are fifteenth in this newly updated Premier League form table.
 In the Premier League form table over the last half dozen games, NUFC with six points from two wins, no draws and four defeats, with six goals scored and eleven conceded.
 As for Newcastle’s opponents on Saturday, these are the last six PL matches that Fulham have played, the very most recent listed first:
 Villa 1 Fulham 1 
 Coventry 0 Fulham 1 
 Fulham 1 Hull 0 
 Ipswich 2 Fulham 1 
 Fulham 1 Man U 1 
 Liverpool 0 Fulham 0
 So Fulham are tenth in the Premier League form table with six points from two wins, three draws and one defeat, scoring five and conceding four.
 Premier League table on the morning of Friday 6 November 2026 
 The full Premier League table showing Fulham fifteenth on nine points, two places and two points below Newcastle United . A win for United would almost certainly see them back in the top half of the table going into the international break, if Fulham win they go above NUFC.
